notes.title: "Project: AHNO's Ark" Coming Soon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39571328/06ebe3664662546aa2266874b3b9734c2e8c2f9b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Don't miss the launch of "Project: AHNO's Ark"![/h3]
Launching on September 19, this game combines Go elements with Roguelite tactical gameplay, featuring a captivating storyline that tests players' strategy and decision-making skills. Add "AHNO's Ark" to your wishlist now and get ready for an apocalyptic journey of rescue and discovery!

notes.title: "Project: AHNO's Ark" has won NYX GAME AWARDS Best Innovation Silver
notes.content:
PHOSEPO's next game "Project: AHNO's Ark" has won the Silver Award for Best Innovation in the NYX Game Competition for its demo version.
Thank you all for your support,
We are very happy to receive this award,
We will continue to work hard!
[h2]Welcome to add to your wishlist!! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631670]"Project: AHNO's Ark" [/url][/h2]
